2608.10920.title: IO Factory: Simulating AI-Enabled Influence Campaigns at Scale
2608.10920.paper_summary: We introduce IO Factory, an AI-driven framework for simulating information and influence campaigns as fully integrated, traceable processes. The threat of digital manipulation now extends beyond persuasive text from individual language models to AI swarms, i.e., persistent groups of coordinated agents that adapt to platform feedback and disguise organized campaigns as ordinary social interaction. Because such campaigns cannot be identified from isolated messages alone, they must be analyzed across a continuous spectrum of planning, platform action, exposure, interpretation, measurement, and adaptation. IO Factory represents this process inside a controlled simulated platform, linking actor roles, platform actions, exposure records, structured model-based evaluations, and configured changes in the simulated population. We implement the architecture and evaluate it across configurations of up to 100,000 agents. The results show that IO Factory executes campaign timelines at scale and produces inspectable evidence of exposure and measured movement in configured belief variables. By recording the actors, objectives, action constraints, exposure paths, and measurement rules used in each run, IO Factory supports reproducible research and red-team analysis of coordinated influence.
2608.10920.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 IO Factory，一個由 AI 驅動的框架，用於模擬信息和影響活動，作為完全整合且可追蹤的過程。數位操控的威脅現在已超越個別語言模型的說服性文本，擴展到 AI 群體，即持續協調的代理人群體，這些群體根據平台反饋進行調整，並將有組織的活動偽裝成普通的社交互動。由於這些活動無法僅從孤立的訊息中識別，因此必須在規劃、平台行動、曝光、解釋、測量和適應的連續光譜中進行分析。IO Factory 在一個受控的模擬平台內表示這一過程，連結行為者角色、平台行動、曝光記錄、結構化的基於模型的評估以及模擬人口中的配置變更。我們實施了這一架構，並在多達 100,000 名代理人的配置中進行評估。結果顯示，IO Factory 能夠在規模上執行活動時間表，並產生可檢查的曝光證據和在配置的信念變數中測量的運動。通過記錄每次運行中使用的行為者、目標、行動限制、曝光路徑和測量規則，IO Factory 支持可重複的研究和對協調影響的紅隊分析。
